Dear Wallace users,

Warning in file(fn, "rb") :
  no fue posible abrir el archivo 'C:\Users\Usuario\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpOCgZ62\raster\r_tmp_2023-12-06_182313.966283_3984_01329.gri': No such file or directory

Any idea?

JL

messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: Error Model visualization
parts:
Are you having this issue within Wallace? Or running an RMD of a session code? 

This usually happens when the rasters aren't in the temporary storage anymore and might need to be loaded in again. Were you using the option to load a previous session? You might just need to return to the env data component and load your rasters in again.

-Bethany
